from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, json

wt=Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/rollout-20261007")

def run(args):
    p=subprocess.run(args,cwd=wt,text=True,capture_output=True,check=False)
    return {"rc":p.returncode,"stdout":p.stdout,"stderr":p.stderr}

print("branch="+run(["git","branch","--show-current"])["stdout"].strip())
print("head="+run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"])["stdout"].strip())
print("status="+repr(run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"])["stdout"]))

for rel in [
    "src/do_again/service/runtime.py",
    "src/do_again/service/daemon.py",
    "src/do_again/cli.py",
    "src/do_again/core/agent.py",
    "tests/test_service.py",
    "tests/test_cli.py",
    "tests/test_executor.py",
]:
    p=wt/rel
    print(f"\n===== {rel} =====")
    if p.is_file():
        text=p.read_text()
        # keep only relevant sections by keyword windows
        lines=text.splitlines()
        keys=("install","restart","runtime","copy","service_status","self_update","bundle_deploy","process","ledger","claim","outbox")
        hits=[i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if any(k in l.lower() for k in keys)]
        spans=[]
        for i in hits:
            spans.append((max(0,i-5),min(len(lines),i+12)))
        merged=[]
        for a,b in sorted(spans):
            if not merged or a>merged[-1][1]+2: merged.append([a,b])
            else: merged[-1][1]=max(merged[-1][1],b)
        for a,b in merged[:20]:
            print(f"--- lines {a+1}-{b} ---")
            print("\n".join(f"{j+1}: {lines[j]}" for j in range(a,b)))
    else:
        print("missing")

print("\n===== tree service =====")
print(run(["find","src/do_again/service","-maxdepth","2","-type","f","-print"])["stdout"])
print("\n===== tree tests rollout-ish =====")
print(run(["find","tests","-maxdepth","1","-type","f","-print"])["stdout"])
